name: promo/landscape
description: Narrated or captioned 16:9 product film: one claim per scene, cut-the-curve seams along the current, staged reveals on narration beats, captions in the bottom safe band, static end card.

scenes.doc: [{ id, kind: title|claim|feature|capture|stat|quote|end, headline?, body?, image?, stat?, label?, items?, start, end, voStart, voDuration }] from scripts/promo/plan.mjs. *word* in a headline marks the accent highlight.

captions.doc: Caption cues [{ start, end, lines, words }].

captionStyle.doc: karaoke lifts each word to fg as it is spoken.

voSrc.doc: Preview audio, assets/vo/mix.wav; null when caption-only.

ledger.doc: Seam ledger; build.mjs writes it beside index.html for scripts/gates/seams.mjs.
